thread:
Eli (AE): FYI -> Montauk Health wants to run montauk-30b-clinical on Dedicated. Requirements: q4_kv variant, prefix KV cache, BYOK HSM, per-request audit logs, and an enterprise SLA. Can we validate pre-POC this week?
Pri (Solutions): yep. Quick checklist: tokenizer check, quant compatibility, kv prefix semantics, memory footprint, and HSM handshake. @Asha can you run a model-check?
Asha (ML): running `ri model-check montauk-30b-clinical --variant q4_kv --checks tokenizer,quant,kvcache` now.
Asha (ML): results: PASS tokenizer (clinical BPE), PASS quant format (q4_kv), PASS kv-prefix semantics. NOTE: model expects rotary embeddings with 8192 max-pos; runtime default 2048 -> recommend long-seq profile or trimmed inputs. Estimated per-shard KV memory ~14GB.
Rory (Infra): Dedicated can handle this. We'll need session affinity to keep KV on-shard. BYOK HSM supported via partner KMS; we'll run a handshake in staging. Burst available as on-demand at +30% over committed rates. Need expected sustained QPS to size commit.
Nina (Security): for healthcare, we need BAAs and field-level logging controls. Per-request audit logs are OK; retention defaults 90 days. We'll need to review their security questionnaire and provide attestation for HSM.
Sam (Legal): I'll queue BAA and DPA templates. Also confirm whether Montauk needs EU data residency.
Eli (AE): action items: Asha run a micro-perf with long-seq enabled if possible; Rory provision a small Dedicated staging pool and test KMS handshake; Nina share security checklist; Sam share BAA. Target: gating sign-off by Friday so POC can start Monday.
Pri (Solutions): sample perf command Asha can use: `ri perf-run --model montauk-30b-clinical --variant q4_kv --seq 4096 --concurrency 150 --kv-prefix`
Asha (ML): will run and post numbers. Quick note: adapter shim may be needed if we decide not to compile long-seq binary; quality impact minimal in our evals.
Eli (AE): thanks team  will consolidate and loop in Montauk with next steps.
